metrics.samples_v4_reduced_last_30m_mv.query: SELECT env, temporality, metric_name, reduced_fingerprint, bucket_unix_milli AS unix_milli, last, min, max, sum, sum_values, count, sum_count_series, count_samples, now() AS computed_at FROM (SELECT env, temporality, metric_name, reduced_fingerprint, intDiv(unix_milli, 1800000) * 1800000 AS bucket_unix_milli, argMax(last, unix_milli) AS last, min(min) AS min, max(max) AS max, sum(sum) AS sum, sum(sum_values) AS sum_values, sum(count) AS count, sum(sum_count_series) AS sum_count_series, sum(count_samples) AS count_samples FROM {db:metrics}.samples_v4_reduced_last_5m FINAL WHERE (unix_milli >= (toUnixTimestamp(now() - toIntervalMinute(180)) * 1000)) AND (unix_milli < (toUnixTimestamp(now() - toIntervalMinute(40)) * 1000)) GROUP BY env, temporality, metric_name, reduced_fingerprint, bucket_unix_milli) WHERE (bucket_unix_milli >= (toUnixTimestamp(now() - toIntervalMinute(150)) * 1000)) AND ((bucket_unix_milli + 1800000) <= (toUnixTimestamp(now() - toIntervalMinute(40)) * 1000))

metrics.samples_v4_reduced_last_5m_mv.refresh: REFRESH EVERY 5 MINUTE RANDOMIZE FOR 30 SECOND APPEND
metrics.samples_v4_reduced_last_5m_mv.query: SELECT env, temporality, metric_name, reduced_fingerprint, bucket_unix_milli AS unix_milli, last, min, max, sum, sum_values, count, sum_count_series, count_samples, now() AS computed_at FROM (SELECT env, temporality, metric_name, reduced_fingerprint, intDiv(unix_milli, 300000) * 300000 AS bucket_unix_milli, argMax(sum_last, unix_milli) AS last, min(min) AS min, max(max) AS max, sum(sum_last) AS sum, sum(sum_values) AS sum_values, count() AS count, sum(count_series) AS sum_count_series, sum(count_samples) AS count_samples FROM {db:metrics}.samples_v4_reduced_last_60s FINAL WHERE (unix_milli >= (toUnixTimestamp(now() - toIntervalMinute(40)) * 1000)) AND (unix_milli < (toUnixTimestamp(now() - toIntervalMinute(12)) * 1000)) GROUP BY env, temporality, metric_name, reduced_fingerprint, bucket_unix_milli) WHERE (bucket_unix_milli >= (toUnixTimestamp(now() - toIntervalMinute(35)) * 1000)) AND ((bucket_unix_milli + 300000) <= (toUnixTimestamp(now() - toIntervalMinute(12)) * 1000))

metrics.samples_v4_reduced_last_60s_mv.refresh: REFRESH EVERY 1 MINUTE RANDOMIZE FOR 10 SECOND APPEND
metrics.samples_v4_reduced_last_60s_mv.query: SELECT env, temporality, metric_name, reduced_fingerprint, bucket_unix_milli AS unix_milli, sum(last) AS sum_last, min(min_value) AS min, max(max_value) AS max, sum(sum_value) AS sum_values, count() AS count_series, sum(num_values) AS count_samples, now() AS computed_at FROM (SELECT env, temporality, metric_name, reduced_fingerprint, fingerprint, intDiv(unix_milli, 60000) * 60000 AS bucket_unix_milli, argMax(value, unix_milli) AS last, min(value) AS min_value, max(value) AS max_value, sum(value) AS sum_value, count(value) AS num_values FROM {db:metrics}.samples_v4_buffer PREWHERE reduced_fingerprint != 0 WHERE (bitAnd(flags, 1) = 0) AND ((temporality = 'Unspecified') OR ((temporality = 'Cumulative') AND (is_monotonic = false))) AND (unix_milli < (toUnixTimestamp(now() - toIntervalSecond(120)) * 1000)) AND (unix_milli >= (toUnixTimestamp(now() - toIntervalMinute(11)) * 1000)) GROUP BY env, temporality, metric_name, reduced_fingerprint, fingerprint, bucket_unix_milli) WHERE bucket_unix_milli >= (toUnixTimestamp(now() - toIntervalMinute(10)) * 1000) GROUP BY env, temporality, metric_name, reduced_fingerprint, bucket_unix_milli

metrics.samples_v4_reduced_sum_60s_cumul.refresh: REFRESH EVERY 1 MINUTE RANDOMIZE FOR 10 SECOND APPEND
metrics.samples_v4_reduced_sum_60s_cumul.query: SELECT env, 'Delta' AS temporality, metric_name, reduced_fingerprint, bucket_unix_milli AS unix_milli, sum(series_increment) AS sum, count() AS count_series, sum(num_values) AS count_samples, now() AS computed_at FROM (SELECT env, temporality, metric_name, reduced_fingerprint, fingerprint, bucket_unix_milli, sum(increment) AS series_increment, count() AS num_values FROM (SELECT env, temporality, metric_name, reduced_fingerprint, fingerprint, intDiv(unix_milli, 60000) * 60000 AS bucket_unix_milli, multiIf(row_number() OVER rate_window = 1, nan, value < lagInFrame(value, 1) OVER rate_window, value, value - lagInFrame(value, 1) OVER rate_window) AS increment FROM {db:metrics}.samples_v4_buffer PREWHERE reduced_fingerprint != 0 WHERE (bitAnd(flags, 1) = 0) AND ((temporality = 'Cumulative') AND (is_monotonic = true)) AND (unix_milli < (toUnixTimestamp(now() - toIntervalSecond(120)) * 1000)) AND (unix_milli >= (toUnixTimestamp(now() - toIntervalMinute(11)) * 1000)) WINDOW rate_window AS (PARTITION BY env, temporality, metric_name, fingerprint ORDER BY unix_milli ASC)) WHERE (isNaN(increment) = 0) AND (bucket_unix_milli >= (toUnixTimestamp(now() - toIntervalMinute(10)) * 1000)) GROUP BY env, temporality, metric_name, reduced_fingerprint, fingerprint, bucket_unix_milli) GROUP BY env, temporality, metric_name, reduced_fingerprint, bucket_unix_milli
